lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like lattice of high-luminance circular clusters posterior to the branchial region, showing increased spatial separation along the longitudinal axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting horizontal rows of blobs, creating a structured rectangular coordinate pattern on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple parallel longitudinal ridges traversing the upper third of the flank, characterized by high-luminance crests and high-contrast shadowed troughs.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of low-resolution circular maxima visible on the leading edge and lateral surface of the first dorsal fin silhouette.
dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, low-luminance silhouettes (commensal organisms) attached to the ventral-lateral surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple elongated, high-contrast silhouettes consistent with Echeneidae attached to the ventral surface.
